Recovery status + money impact for the BrightLoop batch (Julian Brooks, 2026-04-26).

**WHERE EACH EMPLOYEE STANDS**

**Marcus Webb (vehicle) — OPEN.** 2019 Honda Civic (Road Runner ref RR-482991-BOS) stuck at Road Runner's Indianapolis transfer hub since ~4/11 after a driver fell through. Tentative 4/18–20 window (never guaranteed) has passed; no confirmed delivery, no hard date. Escalated to Road Runner dispatch today for a firm appointment. Employee sent an honest update (no soft ETA); next checkpoint EOD Mon 4/27. Airtable updated to active recovery.

**Simone Richter (housing) — OPEN.** Promised a 1BR, placed/left in a studio ~3 weeks; treated as our error. Vendor booking-vs-delivered trace still unconfirmed — UrbanNest (Carmen) has not answered the 6 questions from 4/23, including whether a 1BR is available for immediate transfer, the cost swing on our account, and a service credit. Re-escalated today with a same-day ask. Employee sent a factual reply committing to an outcome by EOD Mon 4/27. Airtable updated to active recovery.

**Priya Naidu (May batch) — SCOPING.** ADA service dog, NOT an ESA — do not reuse the Vectral ESA precedent in landlord/vendor language or notes. Owned by Chloe until housing sourcing is clean. Awaiting accommodation details from Tessa. No spend committed.

**Oliver Bancroft (May batch) — SCOPING.** First real UK→US case; no standing customs/visa workflow or approved shipment partner. Fatimah scoping via the Meridian partner lead; needs BrightLoop to confirm nationality, work authorization, and start date. International exception track, separate from the standard domestic moves. No spend committed; pricing gated on finance sign-off.

**MONEY IMPACT ON THE BATCH**

April cohort — Invoice **INV-2026-0308, $11,350, due 5/2, currently UNPAID** (QB balance $11,350):
- Simone: Standard Relocation $4,500 + Rush Coordination Surcharge $750
- Marcus: Standard Relocation $4,500 + Vehicle Shipping (Road Runner) $1,100
- Stipend Platform Fee $500 (2 × $250)

Most-exposed lines given the two service failures:
- **Marcus vehicle shipping $1,100** — billed to BrightLoop for a service now 2+ weeks late and undelivered; high risk of credit/refund (plus possible carrier cost we absorb) if delivery keeps slipping.
- **Simone rush surcharge $750** — hardest line to defend if BrightLoop pushes on service quality, since the rushed placement is the one that went wrong. Plus an unknown UrbanNest service credit and an unquantified studio→1BR cost swing, neither known until Carmen answers Q5/Q6.

May six-move batch — **NOT yet priced.** Standard three (Leah Kwon, Daniel Okafor, Sofia Reyes) ~ standard domestic; Oliver (international) and Jonathan Marsh (white-glove exec) require finance sign-off before any pricing goes to Tessa. Real upside, unquantified and gated.

**Defensible one-liner:** $11,350 invoiced/unpaid on the April cohort, with ~$1,850 ($1,100 vehicle + $750 rush) as the realistic goodwill/credit exposure on the two failed moves, plus an unquantified UrbanNest credit / 1BR cost delta; May batch unpriced pending finance sign-off on the UK and white-glove lanes.
